messages.content: You are reviewing a long incident report. Context: At 09:12 the runtime began returning HTTP 400 with empty chosen_endpoint_id for exact remote model requests after a partial config PUT. Telemetry showed unknown.endpoint and execution_failed. Later investigation found default throughput SLA hard-denied sub-24 tps remote endpoints when they were the only allow-listed candidate. Strategy C alias routing still worked because local remained eligible. Operators restored routing.strategy via merge-preserving config updates. Question: what were the two root causes and the fixes? Answer in structured bullets.

cases.expected_response: throughput SLA hard-deny; partial config PUT dropped routing.strategy
